plugin.name: Aardwolf_Potion_Quaffer
plugin.author: FesterHead
plugin.purpose: GMCP Vitals tracker with automated bag-pull potion quaffing and manual quaff controls
plugin.description: Monitors GMCP vitals to automatically get and quaff potions from a designated bag. Provides 'pquaff heal' and 'pquaff mana' aliases and Monokai spectrum miniwindow buttons for manual potion quaffing. Displays live counts and interactive action buttons in a draggable miniwindow using Consolas 14pt.

muclient.script:
require "gmcphelper" require "mw_theme_base" require "movewindow"
-- ============================================================================ -- CONFIGURATION (Default values loaded/saved in MUSHclient variables) -- ============================================================================ local POTION_BAG = GetVariable("POTION_BAG") or "backpack" local HP_QUAFF_PERCENT = tonumber(GetVariable("HP_QUAFF_PERCENT")) or 40 local MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT = tonumber(GetVariable("MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT")) or 30 -- ============================================================================
-- Tracked data local potions = { healing = 0, mana = 0 }
-- Adjusted sizes up to scale elegantly with 14pt Consolas local default_width = 270 local default_height = 165 local default_x = 700 local default_y = 200 local LEFT_MARGIN = 14 local TOP_MARGIN = 10
-- File scope variables for correct cross-function visibility local win = GetPluginID() local font_id local line_height local pending_bag local validation_timer local silent_scan = false
-- Hover states for interactive Monokai buttons local heal_hover = false local mana_hover = false
local HEAL_POTION_CMD = GetVariable("HEAL_POTION_CMD") or "healing" local MANA_POTION_CMD = GetVariable("MANA_POTION_CMD") or "mana" local HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST = {} local MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST = {} local scanning_bag = false
local last_scanned_heal_kw = nil local last_scanned_mana_kw = nil
local function extract_item_keyword(item_name, ptype) local name_lower = string.lower(item_name) if ptype == "healing" then if string.find(name_lower, "honey", 1, true) then return "honey" end if string.find(name_lower, "relief", 1, true) then return "relief" end if string.find(name_lower, "cure", 1, true) then return "cure" end if string.find(name_lower, "heal", 1, true) then return "heal" end elseif ptype == "mana" then if string.find(name_lower, "lotus", 1, true) then return "lotus" end if string.find(name_lower, "refresh", 1, true) then return "refresh" end if string.find(name_lower, "mana", 1, true) then return "mana" end end return nil end
local function update_keyword_lists() local heal_str = GetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "healing,heal,cure,light relief,serious relief,critical care,honey"
-- Auto-upgrade old saved variables to include the new defaults if they are missing if not string.find(heal_str, "serious relief", 1, true) then heal_str = heal_str .. ",serious relief" end if not string.find(heal_str, "critical care", 1, true) then heal_str = heal_str .. ",critical care" end if not string.find(heal_str, "honey", 1, true) then heal_str = heal_str .. ",honey" end
local mana_str = GetVariable("MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "mana,refresh,black lotus"
HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST = {} for word in string.gmatch(heal_str, "([^,]+)") do table.insert(HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST, Trim(string.lower(word))) end
MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST = {} for word in string.gmatch(mana_str, "([^,]+)") do table.insert(MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST, Trim(string.lower(word))) end
SetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS", heal_str) end
local function get_potion_type(item_name) local name_lower = string.lower(item_name)
for _, key in ipairs(HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST) do if string.find(name_lower, key, 1, true) then return "healing" end end
for _, key in ipairs(MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS_LIST) do if string.find(name_lower, key, 1, true) then return "mana" end end
return nil end
local has_initial_scanned = false
function OnPluginInstall() update_keyword_lists() font_id = win local font_name = "Consolas" local font_size = 14
local windowinfo = movewindow.install(win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, false, nil, {mouseup=MouseUp}, {x=default_x, y=default_y}) WindowCreate(win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, default_width, default_height, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, Theme.SECONDARY_BODY) WindowFont(win, font_id, font_name, font_size, false, false, false, false, 0)
line_height = WindowFontInfo(win, font_id, 1) + 4
DrawWindow() Note("-> Potion Quaffer Plugin Loaded. Type 'pquaff help' for commands and status.")
if IsConnected() then has_initial_scanned = true QuaffScan() end end
function OnPluginConnect() has_initial_scanned = true QuaffScan() end
function OnPluginClose() WindowDelete(win) end
function MouseOverHeal(flags, hotspot_id) heal_hover = true DrawWindow() end
function MouseOutHeal(flags, hotspot_id) heal_hover = false DrawWindow() end
function QuaffHealClick(flags, hotspot_id) QuaffHealPotion() return true end
function MouseOverMana(flags, hotspot_id) mana_hover = true DrawWindow() end
function MouseOutMana(flags, hotspot_id) mana_hover = false DrawWindow() end
function QuaffManaClick(flags, hotspot_id) QuaffManaPotion() return true end
function QuaffHealPotion() local cmd = HEAL_POTION_CMD if cmd == "healing" and last_scanned_heal_kw then cmd = last_scanned_heal_kw end if potions.healing <= 0 then Note("-> [Warning]: No healing potions tracked in " .. POTION_BAG .. ". Attempting get/quaff anyway.") else potions.healing = math.max(0, potions.healing - 1) end Send(string.format("get %s '%s'", cmd, POTION_BAG)) Send(string.format("quaff %s", cmd)) DrawWindow() end
function QuaffManaPotion() local cmd = MANA_POTION_CMD if cmd == "mana" and last_scanned_mana_kw then cmd = last_scanned_mana_kw end if potions.mana <= 0 then Note("-> [Warning]: No mana potions tracked in " .. POTION_BAG .. ". Attempting get/quaff anyway.") else potions.mana = math.max(0, potions.mana - 1) end Send(string.format("get %s '%s'", cmd, POTION_BAG)) Send(string.format("quaff %s", cmd)) DrawWindow() end
function DrawWindow() local bodyleft, bodytop, bodyright, bodybottom = Theme.DrawBorder(win) WindowRectOp(win, 2, bodyleft, bodytop, bodyright+1, bodybottom+1, Theme.PRIMARY_BODY)
Theme.DrawTitleBar(win, font_id, " Potion Tracker", "center")
-- Restrict drag handler to title bar (0 to 22px height) so buttons are not covered movewindow.add_drag_handler(win, 0, 0, 0, 22)
local top = TOP_MARGIN + line_height
WindowText(win, font_id, string.format("Healing (<%d%%):", HP_QUAFF_PERCENT), LEFT_MARGIN, top, 0, 0, Theme.BODY_TEXT) WindowText(win, font_id, string.format("%3d", potions.healing), LEFT_MARGIN + 190, top, 0, 0, potions.healing > 0 and 0x2EE2A6 or 0x7226F9)
top = top + line_height WindowText(win, font_id, string.format("Mana (<%d%%):", MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT), LEFT_MARGIN, top, 0, 0, Theme.BODY_TEXT) WindowText(win, font_id, string.format("%3d", potions.mana), LEFT_MARGIN + 190, top, 0, 0, potions.mana > 0 and 0xEFD966 or 0x7226F9)
top = top + line_height WindowText(win, font_id, "Bag:", LEFT_MARGIN, top, 0, 0, Theme.BODY_TEXT) WindowText(win, font_id, POTION_BAG, LEFT_MARGIN + 60, top, 0, 0, Theme.BODY_TEXT)
-- Monokai Spectrum Buttons top = top + line_height + 8 local btn_height = 28 local btn_width = 114
-- Heal Button (Monokai Green #A6E22E -> BGR 0x2EE2A6) local heal_left = LEFT_MARGIN local heal_right = heal_left + btn_width local heal_bg = heal_hover and 0x1A4232 or 0x10271E local heal_border = 0x2EE2A6 local heal_text_color = heal_hover and 0xFFFFFF or 0x2EE2A6
WindowRectOp(win, miniwin.rect_fill, heal_left, top, heal_right, top + btn_height, heal_bg) WindowRectOp(win, miniwin.rect_frame, heal_left, top, heal_right, top + btn_height, heal_border)
local heal_text = "Quaff Heal" local heal_text_w = WindowTextWidth(win, font_id, heal_text) local heal_text_x = heal_left + math.floor((btn_width - heal_text_w) / 2) local heal_text_y = top + math.floor((btn_height - WindowFontInfo(win, font_id, 1)) / 2) WindowText(win, font_id, heal_text, heal_text_x, heal_text_y, heal_right, top + btn_height, heal_text_color)
if WindowHotspotInfo(win, "btn_quaff_heal", 1) == nil then WindowAddHotspot( win, "btn_quaff_heal", heal_left, top, heal_right, top + btn_height, "MouseOverHeal", "MouseOutHeal", "", "", "QuaffHealClick", "Click to quaff a Healing potion (pquaff heal)", 1, 0 ) end
-- Mana Button (Monokai Cyan #66D9EF -> BGR 0xEFD966) local mana_left = heal_right + 14 local mana_right = mana_left + btn_width local mana_bg = mana_hover and 0x473A1E or 0x2B2311 local mana_border = 0xEFD966 local mana_text_color = mana_hover and 0xFFFFFF or 0xEFD966
WindowRectOp(win, miniwin.rect_fill, mana_left, top, mana_right, top + btn_height, mana_bg) WindowRectOp(win, miniwin.rect_frame, mana_left, top, mana_right, top + btn_height, mana_border)
local mana_text = "Quaff Mana" local mana_text_w = WindowTextWidth(win, font_id, mana_text) local mana_text_x = mana_left + math.floor((btn_width - mana_text_w) / 2) local mana_text_y = top + math.floor((btn_height - WindowFontInfo(win, font_id, 1)) / 2) WindowText(win, font_id, mana_text, mana_text_x, mana_text_y, mana_right, top + btn_height, mana_text_color)
if WindowHotspotInfo(win, "btn_quaff_mana", 1) == nil then WindowAddHotspot( win, "btn_quaff_mana", mana_left, top, mana_right, top + btn_height, "MouseOverMana", "MouseOutMana", "", "", "QuaffManaClick", "Click to quaff a Mana potion (pquaff mana)", 1, 0 ) end
WindowShow(win, true) CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") end
function MouseUp(flags, hotspot_id, win) return true end
-- AUTOMATED QUAFFER LOGIC via GMCP function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) if (id == '3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264') then if (text == "char.base" or text == "char.status" or text == "char.vitals") then if not has_initial_scanned then has_initial_scanned = true QuaffScan() end end if (text == "char.vitals") then local gmcpchar = gmcp("char") if gmcpchar and gmcpchar.vitals and gmcpchar.maxstats then
local hp_pct = (tonumber(gmcpchar.vitals.hp) / tonumber(gmcpchar.maxstats.maxhp)) * 100 local mana_pct = (tonumber(gmcpchar.vitals.mana) / tonumber(gmcpchar.maxstats.maxmana)) * 100
-- Check HP Threshold if hp_pct < HP_QUAFF_PERCENT and potions.healing > 0 then QuaffHealPotion() -- Check Mana Threshold elseif mana_pct < MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT and potions.mana > 0 then QuaffManaPotion() end end end end end
-- INVENTORY & BAG TRACKING LOGIC function HandlePutPotion(name, line, wildcards) local qty_str = wildcards[1] local item_name = wildcards[2] local dest_bag = wildcards[4]
local qty = 1 if qty_str ~= "a" and qty_str ~= "an" then qty = tonumber(qty_str) or 1 end
if string.find(string.lower(dest_bag), string.lower(POTION_BAG), 1, true) then local ptype = get_potion_type(item_name) if ptype then potions[ptype] = potions[ptype] + qty DrawWindow() end end end
function HandleGetPotion(name, line, wildcards) local qty_str = wildcards[1] local item_name = wildcards[2] local source_bag = wildcards[3]
local qty = 1 if qty_str ~= "a" and qty_str ~= "an" then qty = tonumber(qty_str) or 1 end
if string.find(string.lower(source_bag), string.lower(POTION_BAG), 1, true) then local ptype = get_potion_type(item_name) if ptype then potions[ptype] = math.max(0, potions[ptype] - qty) DrawWindow() end end end
function HandleEmptyBag(name, line, wildcards) local matched_bag = wildcards[2] or wildcards[1] if string.find(string.lower(matched_bag), string.lower(POTION_BAG), 1, true) then potions.healing = 0 potions.mana = 0 DrawWindow() if silent_scan then DeleteLines(1) silent_scan = false Note("-> Potion bag scanned successfully (bag is empty).") end end end
function StartBagScan(name, line, wildcards) local matched_bag = wildcards[2] or wildcards[1] if string.find(string.lower(matched_bag), string.lower(POTION_BAG), 1, true) then scanning_bag = true potions.healing = 0 potions.mana = 0 EnableTriggerGroup("bag_scanner", true) if silent_scan then DeleteLines(1) end end end
function ScanBagItem(name, line, wildcards) if not scanning_bag then return end if silent_scan then DeleteLines(1) end
local qty_str = wildcards[1] local item_name = wildcards[2]
local qty = 1 if qty_str and qty_str ~= "" then qty = tonumber(qty_str) or 1 end
local ptype = get_potion_type(item_name) if ptype then potions[ptype] = potions[ptype] + qty local kw = extract_item_keyword(item_name, ptype) if kw then if ptype == "healing" then last_scanned_heal_kw = kw end if ptype == "mana" then last_scanned_mana_kw = kw end end end end
function EndBagScan(name, line, wildcards) if scanning_bag then scanning_bag = false EnableTriggerGroup("bag_scanner", false) if silent_scan then DeleteLines(1) silent_scan = false Note("-> Potion bag scanned successfully.") end DrawWindow() end end
function OnPluginSaveState() movewindow.save_state(win) SetVariable("POTION_BAG", POTION_BAG) SetVariable("HP_QUAFF_PERCENT", tostring(HP_QUAFF_PERCENT)) SetVariable("MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT", tostring(MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT)) SetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS", GetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "healing,heal,cure,light relief,serious relief,critical care,honey") SetVariable("MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS", GetVariable("MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "mana,refresh,black lotus") SetVariable("HEAL_POTION_CMD", HEAL_POTION_CMD) SetVariable("MANA_POTION_CMD", MANA_POTION_CMD) end
function SetPotionBag(new_bag) pending_bag = Trim(new_bag) EnableTriggerGroup("bag_validator", true) SendNoEcho("look in " .. pending_bag)
-- Set a 2-second temporary one-shot timeout to disable validation triggers if the MUD doesn't respond DeleteTimer("bag_validator_timeout") AddTimer("bag_validator_timeout", 0, 0, 2, "", 21, "BagValidationTimeout") end
function BagValidationTimeout() if pending_bag then EnableTriggerGroup("bag_validator", false) pending_bag = nil Note("-> [ERROR]: Potion bag validation timed out. No response from MUD.") end end
function BagValidationSuccess(name, line, wildcards) DeleteTimer("bag_validator_timeout") EnableTriggerGroup("bag_validator", false) POTION_BAG = pending_bag pending_bag = nil SaveState() DrawWindow() Note("-> Potion bag successfully validated and set to: " .. POTION_BAG) end
function BagValidationFailure(name, line, wildcards) DeleteTimer("bag_validator_timeout") EnableTriggerGroup("bag_validator", false) pending_bag = nil Note("-> [ERROR]: Potion bag validation failed. MUD returned: '" .. line .. "'") Note("-> Potion bag remains set to: " .. POTION_BAG) end
function SetHPQuaffThreshold(percent) if percent >= 0 and percent <= 100 then HP_QUAFF_PERCENT = percent SaveState() DrawWindow() Note("-> Healing potion quaff threshold updated to: " .. HP_QUAFF_PERCENT .. "%") else Note("-> Error: Percent must be between 0 and 100.") end end
function SetManaQuaffThreshold(percent) if percent >= 0 and percent <= 100 then MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT = percent SaveState() DrawWindow() Note("-> Mana potion quaff threshold updated to: " .. MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT .. "%") else Note("-> Error: Percent must be between 0 and 100.") end end
function SetHealKeys(keys_str) SetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS", keys_str) update_keyword_lists() SaveState() Note("-> Potion healing keywords updated to: " .. keys_str) end
function SetManaKeys(keys_str) SetVariable("MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS", keys_str) update_keyword_lists() SaveState() Note("-> Potion mana keywords updated to: " .. keys_str) end
function SetHealCmd(cmd) HEAL_POTION_CMD = Trim(cmd) SaveState() Note("-> Potion healing command keyword set to: " .. HEAL_POTION_CMD) end
function SetManaCmd(cmd) MANA_POTION_CMD = Trim(cmd) SaveState() Note("-> Potion mana command keyword set to: " .. MANA_POTION_CMD) end
function QuaffHelp() local heal_keys = GetVariable("HEAL_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "healing,heal,cure,light relief,serious relief,critical care" local mana_keys = GetVariable("MANA_POTION_KEYWORDS") or "mana,refresh,black lotus"
ColourNote("#808080", "", "\n+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#A6E22E", "", " Aardwolf Potion Quaffer v1.1 Help Menu") ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+") ColourNote("#F8F8F2", "", " Monitors GMCP vitals and automatically gets/quaffs potions.") ColourNote("#808080", "", "-------------------------------------------------------------------") ColourNote("#66D9EF", "", " Commands:") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff heal / pquaff h ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Manually get and quaff a healing potion") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff mana / pquaff m ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Manually get and quaff a mana potion") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff bag <bag> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Set/validate container (current: " .. POTION_BAG .. ")") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff hp <%> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Set HP threshold percentage (current: " .. HP_QUAFF_PERCENT .. "%)") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff mana <%> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Set Mana threshold percentage (current: " .. MANA_QUAFF_PERCENT .. "%)") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff heal_keys <keys> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Substrings to scan heal potions") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff mana_keys <keys> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Substrings to scan mana potions") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff heal_cmd <kw> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Command used to get/quaff heal (current: " .. HEAL_POTION_CMD .. ")") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff mana_cmd <kw> ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Command used to get/quaff mana (current: " .. MANA_POTION_CMD .. ")") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff scan ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Silently scan and sync bag potion counts") ColourNote("#E6DB74", "", " pquaff help / pquaff ", "#F8F8F2", "", "- Show this help menu") ColourNote("#808080", "", "-------------------------------------------------------------------") ColourNote("#66D9EF", "", " Current Keywords Configuration:") ColourNote("#F8F8F2", "", " Heal Match Keys : " .. heal_keys) ColourNote("#F8F8F2", "", " Mana Match Keys : " .. mana_keys) ColourNote("#808080", "", "+=================================================================+\n") end
function QuaffScan() silent_scan = true SendNoEcho("look in " .. POTION_BAG) end
